tiers.A: Safe for AI. Facts and procedures that primary sources can confirm, with no methodology or theology call. The AI researches and drafts. A separate fact-check pass and one editor review follow.
tiers.B: AI drafts after a ruling. The topic is practical, but it rests on a methodology or pastoral choice. The AI first writes a one-page stance memo with options. Bryan reviews it (Sebastian may approve instead), then the AI drafts and the same person approves.
tiers.C: Human-led. Theology, pastoral care or core methodology. The AI may only collect sources and summarize them for the human author.
tiers.F: Fix an existing article. A factual error or an outdated fact was found in a published article.
